blocks.selection: Generate connected boards by uniform choice among feasible nonoverlapping adjacent placements; reject translation duplicates across both conditions. No difficulty selection.
blocks.state_report: board_after: array of ten length-ten binary strings after each removal

path.orientation: Independent hidden random topological permutation per graph; direct every base edge forward in that order.
path.pair_selection: Reject DAGs with no eligible pair, then uniformly choose among ordered pairs whose shortest distance is at least minimum_shortest_moves.
path.presentation: Independently shuffle node rows and each outgoing neighbor list, fixed across eight replicates.
